name: Vera Blanc and the Carpathian Horror
source:
Take on the role of Vera Blanc, a beautiful young woman who, after brain surgery, gained the extraordinary ability to read other people's minds! Daughter of multi-millionaire Emmanuel Blanc, Vera left her life of luxury to work alongside paranormal detective Brandon Mackey (former FBI agent). Be immersed in the world of the supernatural as you play the detective!

Travel with Vera to Romania as she hunts a vampire who attacked her detective partner.

Will you be able to solve the mystery?
